verdict.rationale: The payment-acceptance docs name USDC and USDT as accepted stablecoins, and USDC flows recur across deposit, payout and treasury docs. Networks are only mentioned in passing (Base for the agentic wallet and trading, EVM and Solana in the SDK, Ethereum addresses for sends), with no consolidated matrix of which stablecoins work on which named chains for payments. Missing for 10: an explicit supported-assets-by-network table for payment acceptance, stablecoins beyond USDC/USDT, and independent corroboration of chain coverage.
